2027-02-05.title: Friday after Aneede Sunday
readings: Written down to instruct us; God is faithful
If the world hates you, it hated me first
2027-02-05.verse: If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you.
theo: Paul looks back at Israel in the wilderness. They had every gift: “our ancestors were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea… and all ate the same spiritual food, and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.” Yet “God was not pleased with most of them.” They desired evil, worshipped idols, tested the Lord and grumbled. “These things happened to them to serve as an example, and they were written down to instruct us.” Baptism and the Eucharist are not a charm that saves us without our cooperation. “So if you think you are standing, watch out that you do not fall.” And at once Paul adds the comfort: “God is faithful, and he will not let you be tested beyond your strength, but with the testing he will also provide the way out so that you may be able to endure it.”

In the Gospel Jesus prepares his friends for another kind of testing, the hostility of the world: “If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you… Servants are not greater than their master. If they persecuted me, they will persecute you.” The disciples are hated not for their faults but because they belong to him: “I have chosen you out of the world.” On this Friday, the day of the Cross, we remember Christians in India and across the world who suffer for the name of Jesus. As the Great Fast approaches, Paul's warning and Jesus' promise belong together: watch, because you can fall; take heart, because God is faithful and Christ has gone ahead of you. St John Chrysostom says that Paul names the way out together with the trial, so that no one may despair (in substance).
outline: Ask: can a baptized person who receives Communion still fall away?
Point 1 · Written down to instruct us
The servant shares the master's road.
“It hated me before it hated you.”
live: Name one habit that could make you fall, and plan how to avoid it during the Fast.
Pray today for Christians who suffer for their faith, and learn about one such community.
2027-02-05.prayer: Lord Jesus, you were hated without a cause and you went before us on the way of the Cross. Keep us watchful so that we do not fall, and faithful when we are tested. Strengthen all who suffer for your name today, and give them the way out that you have promised. Amen.
altar: Israel drank from the rock, and the rock was Christ; in the Holy Qurbono we drink from his side the true spiritual drink.

quick: Israel had all God's gifts and still fell in the wilderness.
God is faithful and will not let us be tested beyond our strength.
The world that hated Jesus will also hate his disciples.
2027-02-05.action: Pray today for Christians who are persecuted for their faith.
2027-02-05.question: Do I think I am standing so firmly that I no longer watch?

family.explain: Sometimes it is hard to be good. Paul says God is faithful: he never gives us a test that is too big for us, and he always shows us a way out.
family.intention: We pray for Christians who are hurt or chased away because they love Jesus.
family.ask: Ask: “What is one thing that often makes me do wrong, and how can we help each other avoid it?”

illus: A young man from Pathanamthitta working in a Gulf city told his parish group how he had nearly given up praying. His roommates mocked him and his manager scheduled work on Sundays. One night, ready to stop, he found a small Malankara community meeting in a flat two streets away. They prayed the evening Ramsho in Malayalam. He said: God did not take the test away, but he showed me the door out of loneliness.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you are faithful. Keep us standing in the time of testing. Amen.
share: The rock was Christ (1 Corinthians 10:4). Where do I drink from each day?
So if you think you are standing, watch out that you do not fall (1 Corinthians 10:12). Where am I overconfident?
If they persecuted me, they will persecute you (John 15:20). How do I respond when I am mocked for my faith?
pm.resp: Lord, be our strength in testing.
interc: For Christians persecuted in India and in other lands.
For those tempted to give up their faith.
For young people living far from home and Church.
For all who struggle with addictions.
For our parish as the Great Fast draws near.
pm.close: Father, you are faithful and never let us be tested beyond our strength. Hold us fast in the hour of trial and bring us safely through it. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Paul reminds us that Israel passed through the sea, ate the manna and drank from the rock, and the rock was Christ. Yet most of them fell in the wilderness (1 Corinthians 10:4–5).
These things were written down to instruct us. So if you think you are standing, watch out that you do not fall (1 Corinthians 10:11–12). Grace is not a charm; it calls for watchfulness.
But Paul adds at once: God is faithful, and he will not let you be tested beyond your strength, but with the testing he will also provide the way out (1 Corinthians 10:13).

Jesus tells us not to be surprised if the world hates us: it hated him first (John 15:18). On this Friday, let us pray for persecuted Christians, and enter the coming Fast watchful and full of trust. Amen.
kids: Children, sometimes it is hard to do what is right. But God is faithful! He never gives us a test that is too big, and he always shows us a way out. Ask him for help when you are tempted.

intro: Theme: “If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you.”
Paul's warning from the wilderness and Jesus' word to the persecuted.

q: Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
So if you think you are standing, watch out that you do not fall.
points.apply: Name one temptation you will guard against during the Fast.

q: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you; when you walk through fire you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not consume you.
God is faithful, and he will not let you be tested beyond your strength,
points.apply: In your next temptation, stop and ask God to show you the way out.

q: More in number than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause;
If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you.
points.apply: Pray for persecuted Christians each Friday of the Great Fast.

concl: Grace received must be guarded with watchfulness.
God is faithful to those who suffer for his name.
2027-02-05.resolve: Choose one Friday act of prayer for the persecuted Church and keep it through the Fast.
